title: Quanta Services, Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: At June 30, 2026, cash was USD 506.4 million, current debt was USD 683.0 million, long-term debt was USD 5.422 billion, and goodwill was USD 7.869 billion.
summary: Quanta's Q2 Form 10-Q confirms the raised operating base and backlog while retaining acquisition, leverage, goodwill, contract, labor and project-conversion risks; first-half operating cash flow was USD 1.487 billion.
